_about: "listing_status": "checked" = details entered and checked by the Harrow Online team (icon: Checked by Harrow Online); without it a claimed listing is Verified by the business (the real businesses Harrow Online supplied). Claimed businesses for the design preview. Entries WITHOUT "real": true are fictional samples: names, addresses and offers are made up; phone numbers use Ofcom's reserved drama range (020 7946 0xxx). Entries WITH "real": true are real businesses supplied by Harrow Online (no Sample label, indexable). Real-only optional fields: website, email, logo, image_alts, social_urls, status + schedule_title + schedule + schedule_note (instead of 7-day hours), other_locations, verified_note, replaces (unclaimed listing ids it takes over), service_area (mobile business: no address), cover + cover_bg + cover_alt (own cover image, shown whole on that colour), phones_extra, hours_note, seo_title (page title for very long names), slug (cleaner URL). Offers of real businesses may leave out ends (no end date). In WordPress this data comes from claimed listings, offers and events. tier: basic | enhanced | premium | partner. Days: Mon..Sun.

There is a heated garden terrace for warmer evenings, a private room for up to 20, and a children's menu all week. We host a live jazz supper club once a month.

businesses.name: Kodak FC
businesses.address: Harrow Weald Recreation Ground, Boxtree Lane
businesses.tagline: Grassroots football club in Harrow Weald since 1935, with adult and youth teams and FA-qualified coaches for its young players.
description: Kodak (Harrow) Football Club, known as Kodak FC, has been part of Harrow’s grassroots football since 1935. It was first formed for workers at the Kodak factory on Headstone Drive, and today plays at Harrow Weald Recreation Ground, also known as Boxtree Park.

The club runs several senior teams in the Middlesex County Football League, with the First Team in the Premier Division, and a youth section in the Harrow Youth Football League. Youth teams are coached by FA-qualified coaches, with the focus on skills, confidence, friendship and enjoying the game. Kodak FC is an FA Accredited club.

Honours include the Middlesex Intermediate Cup in 2006, the Middlesex County League Division 1 North West title in 2022 and the Alec Smith Premier Division Cup in 2023/24. New players of all ages and abilities are welcome, and so are volunteers. The ground has grass pitches, changing rooms, parking and a coffee shop in the park.
businesses.schedule_note: Training times depend on the team and age group. Call the club to find the right team.
